instruction: Start from a template `/home/user/Desktop/curve_base.py`. Complete the following from the command line: 1. Write a complete script `/home/user/Desktop/curve.py`: - Build a single-turbine wind farm (NREL 5MW) - Sweep wind speeds: `4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20 m/s` - For each wind speed, execute `run_no_wake()` (to avoid wake interference) - Extract power (kW) and thrust coefficient `Ct` 2. Execute and save to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `ws4_p_kw, ws4_ct, ws8_p_kw, ws8_ct, ws12_p_kw, ws12_ct, ws20_p_kw, ws20_ct` 3. Do not use any GUI. [Software] Run your scripts with Python in an environment where `floris` is installed (e.g. `from floris import FlorisModel`). On this machine, FLORIS is provided as the Python `floris` package at `/home/user/.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/floris`; run the workflow from Python rather than looking for a separate desktop program.
